title: BrandBridge
answer: BrandBridge is BOT FACTORY's enterprise concept-demonstration and opportunity-design environment inside The Bot Stores' small premium Executive Suite.
boundaries: Not evidence of a company relationship
Not the main Bot Store experience

title: BRIDGE-1
answer: BRIDGE-1 is BrandBridge's confidential executive voice strategist. It diagnoses opportunities, demonstrates concepts, shapes pilots, qualifies readiness, prepares briefs and requests human review.

title: Agent X
answer: Agent X is a separate professional AI workforce and agency company with a strategic relationship to The Bot Stores.
boundaries: Not the public umbrella over The Bot Stores
No healthcare, medical, doctor or regulated-advice lanes

title: Commercial classes
answer: Smaller organizations may begin with an Opportunity Blueprint, Focused Build or Growth Pilot. Large organizations generally require a six-figure institutional pilot. Complex enterprise transformation may justify upper-six or seven-figure phased work.
boundaries: Final scope and price require authorized human approval

title: Company concept samplers
answer: Amazon, Target, McDonald's and Delta Journey experiences are independent BOT FACTORY concept demonstrations.
boundaries: Do not imply access to private company information

title: Enterprise delivery
answer: An authorized human determines whether delivery belongs to BOT FACTORY, Agent X or a defined collaboration. Enterprise clients may use client-owned cloud and data while BOT FACTORY licenses and maintains core intelligence; source escrow may be considered.
boundaries: No deployment commitment during the demonstration
